script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

Title: Resurrection

INT. RESEARCH LAB - NIGHT

DR. ELLIOT (50s, brilliant scientist, disheveled) hunches over an ancient artifact. The room is dimly lit, filled with the hum of machinery.

ASSISTANT (30s, serious, in lab coat)
Dr. Elliot, the results of the latest test are in. The energy source is stable. Are you ready to proceed?

DR. ELLIOT
Yes, I'm ready.

INT. RESEARCH LAB - LATER

The machine hums louder. The air crackles with electricity. Suddenly, the machine comes to life, emitting a bright, pulsing light. A figure emerges. It's ALEX (30s, athletic, confused), dressed in modern clothing.

DR. ELLIOT (whispering)
Alexander Thompson... you're back.

INT. RESEARCH LAB - THE NEXT DAY

Alex, disoriented, looks around the lab. He sees Dr. Elliot.

ALEX
Dr. Elliot? What's going on?

DR. ELLIOT
You've been frozen for 200 years, Alex. The world has changed. I've brought you back to help us face a new crisis.

ALEX (dubious)
A crisis? What kind?

INT. CITY STREET - DAY

Alex and Dr. Elliot walk through a bustling city. They pass by giant holographic ads and flying cars.

DR. ELLIOT
The world has advanced technologically. But with this progress comes new challenges. A company, GenTech, is trying to weaponize human cloning.

INT. GENTECH FACILITY - NIGHT

Alex and Dr. Elliot sneak into GenTech's facility. They overhear a conversation between the CEO and a scientist.

CEO (40s, ruthless)
If we can clone an army, we'll have unlimited power.

SCIENTIST (30s, nervous)
But cloning humans... it's morally wrong.

CEO
Morals are for the weak. We'll proceed.

INT. RESEARCH LAB - THE NEXT DAY

Alex and Dr. Elliot work to stop GenTech. They create a virus to infect their cloning machines.

INT. GENTECH FACILITY - NIGHT

Alex and Dr. Elliot infiltrate GenTech once more, this time to plant the virus. They're discovered and chase ensues.

INT. GENTECH FACILITY - LATER

They reach the main cloning chamber. Alex plants the virus. The room fills with the sound of malfunctioning machines.

INT. RESEARCH LAB - DAY

Alex and Dr. Elliot return, victorious. The world is safe once more.

ALEX
What now, Dr. Elliot?

DR. ELLIOT
You have a new career, Alex. You're a hero. And I believe there's more work to be done.

INT. RESEARCH LAB - LATER

Alex, now a hero, looks out at the world with determination. He's ready for his new life.

FADE OUT.
